protocol: Composite of sequential isolated profile runs. Every timed trial checked for physical residual, requested spectrum, M-orthogonality, complete harmonic space and positive guards. Numerical acceptance and strict counts are separate. Setup/capture/reference/validation excluded; warm synchronized median of three. No competing GPU process observed. Failed and strict-incomplete profiles retained, not speedups. No Krylov default, CG recurrence or upstream preconditioner changes. Diagnostic scaled-RHS guesses use the unchanged upstream CG state and are not production functionality.
